readings.Aries: Someone is ready to follow your lead. Be worth following. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Taurus: Someone around you is moving faster than you're comfortable with. Your pace is not wrong. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Gemini: Your mind generates options at a rate that makes choosing feel like loss. It isn't. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Cancer: The mood has been difficult and you've been managing it alone. That arrangement can change. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Leo: There is something you've been brave about that you haven't acknowledged to yourself. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Virgo: You've been waiting for everything to be in place before you begin. It won't ever all be in place. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Libra: Something in your life has drifted out of alignment. Your instinct for it is excellent. Trust it. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Scorpio: What you call jealousy is a diagnostic tool for what you care about most. Use it accordingly. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Sagittarius: The question you're asking is good. The answer you're expecting is limiting the search. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Capricorn: The patience you've shown is remarkable. It is not infinite. Know when you're close to the edge. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Aquarius: Something you've intellectualised needs to be felt. The feeling is safe. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Pisces: The mood that comes in like water recedes like water too. Stay with it until it does. The window for this is shorter than it looks.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
